To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the action of alcohol occurs on the G‐protein‐activated K+ channels downstream of the γ‐aminibutyric acid B receptor in midbrain dopaminergenic neurons.
ethanol enhances GABAB–mediated inhibitory transmission in rat midbrain dopamine neurons by facilitating G‐protein‐activated inwardly rectifying K+ (GIRK, Kir3.0/3.1/3.2) channels.
ethanol enhances the inhibitory GABAB‐IPSP on rat midbrain dopamine neurons through the potentiation of GIRK currents, which are activated by GABAB receptors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms of action underlying the effects of alcohol on dopaminergic neurons.
the effects of ethanol on the GABAB‐GIRK system of rat midbrain dopaminerigc neurons.
the mechanisms by which ethanol enhances GABAB receptor‐mediated inhibitions on dopaminergic neurons and the role of this mechanism in alcoholism.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ethanol potentiates the GABAB‐receptor‐mediated IPSPs by increasing the activity of the GIRK channels.
ethanol potentiates GABAB receptor‐induced GIRK currents, and this effect may contribute to the actions of ethanol in midbrain dopaminergenic neurons.
the action of the ethanol on the GABAB‐IPSPs and the GIRK currents is not mediated through a classical G‐protein cascade, but rather by an unknown pathway.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

ethanol enhances GABAB IPSPs in midbrain dopaminergie neurons through a facilitation of G protein‐gated inwardly rectifying K+ (GIRKs) channels, and that this action is mediated downstream of GABAB receptor activation.
ethanol enhances GABAB–GIRK currents by facilitating the activity of the G‐protein‐coupled inwardly rectifying K+ channel.
ethanol potentiates GABAB‐IPSP by increasing GIRK currents in midbrain dopaminergie neurons.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ethanol potentiates GABAB receptor function in dopaminergic neurons of the midbrain.
ethanol potentiates the GABAB‐IPSPs by enhancing the GIRK currents.

the ethanol‐induced enhancement of GABAB‐IPSPs and GABAB‐GIRK currents in dopaminergic neurons is mediated by a postsynaptic action on GABAB receptors and G‐protein‐coupled GIRK channels, respectively.
